subject: Intro Block Coding
arc_note: K-frame (Problem Solving & Innovating) — NO C3 codes, NO text code, NO loops. The distinct lane is the BLOCK STACK: a program is a stack of coloured ScratchJr-style blocks that SNAP together and run TOP-TO-BOTTOM, one block at a time. This is what separates it from the other two K subjects — Unplugged CT (classify/pattern/sort lane) and Sequencing & Algorithms (loose directional arrows on a 1D path board). Here the program is a tangible object: a green GO/flag start block (cat 'operators', glyph ⚑) on top, then blue MOVE blocks (cat 'motion', single arrow glyph ➡ ⬅ ⬆ ⬇). Built with the `blocks` part at size 'lg' so a single symbol reads large (NOT emoji — too small). The arc weights block STRUCTURE (what a block is, the start block, run-order, block types, build/fix a stack) over path-tracing; when an outcome IS shown it's a tiny 1D stage rendered with the `symbols` row (Bit + ★), ≤4 move blocks, 1D so only ➡/⬅ trace. Every answer (the start block, the run order, each block's direction, the landing cell, the missing/buggy block) is MODELLED + asserted in solution.py. Picture/symbol-driven; adult reads the short prompt, child circles/draws/writes the arrow. Bit is the actor the stack controls and models each worked example.

topics.title: Meet the Blocks
topics.concept: a program is a stack of blocks; the green GO/flag block on top starts it — find the start block
topics.ct_skill: what a block / a program is

topics.title: Run It Top to Bottom
topics.concept: a stack runs from the top block down, one block at a time — number the blocks in run order

topics.title: Move Blocks
topics.concept: each move block tells Bit one way to go (➡ ⬅ ⬆ ⬇) — match each block to its direction

topics.title: Read Bit's Stack
topics.concept: read a short stack (GO + move blocks) and find where Bit lands on the stage

topics.title: Finish the Stack
topics.concept: a stack is missing one block to reach the star — choose the move block that completes it

topics.title: Match the Stack
topics.concept: match a block stack to the picture of what Bit does — same stack, same result

topics.title: Build Bit's Stack
topics.concept: make a short program — draw the arrows in the blank blocks to get Bit to the star

topics.title: Fix the Stack
topics.concept: debugging — one block points the wrong way so Bit misses the star; find it and fix it
